LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Spear.label: river spear
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Spear.description: A light spear of acacia wood with a socketed bronze head shaped like a lotus leaf.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Spear.tools.0.label: shaft
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Spear.tools.1.label: point
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khopesh.label: khopesh
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khopesh.description: A bronze-coloured sickle-sword whose curved outer edge bites like an axe and whose hook pulls shields and spears aside.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khopesh.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khopesh.tools.1.label: edge
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Khopesh.tools.2.label: spike
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_CompositeBow.label: composite bow
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_CompositeBow.description: A short, angled bow of horn, wood and sinew, painted with lotus bands. Charioteers shoot it from a moving platform.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_CompositeBow.tools.0.label: limb
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DesertRifle.label: desert rifle
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DesertRifle.description: A long, slim rifle with a brass-bound stock and a falcon engraved on the lock. Slow to aim, but deadly across open ground.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DesertRifle.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_DesertRifle.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Hedj.label: hedj mace
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Hedj.description: A pear-shaped mace head of white stone on a gold-bound haft. In the oldest carvings the king raises it over his enemies.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Hedj.tools.0.label: handle
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Hedj.tools.1.label: head
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Musket.label: Kemetic musket
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Musket.description: A long musket bound in brass, its stock inlaid with turquoise and a lotus on the butt. Made in the arsenals of the river, with a long barrel that reaches further than most muskets.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Musket.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_Musket.tools.1.label: barrel
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_NileCarbine.label: Nile carbine
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_NileCarbine.description: A carbine with a long barrel for its kind, a brass-bound stock and a lotus on the butt plate. It reaches further than other carbines, and it is cut to stay clean in the sand.
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_NileCarbine.tools.0.label: stock
LanguageData.HE_Kemet_NileCarbine.tools.1.label: barrel
